steps.path: Click the tag element in the bottom status bar
steps.headline: Your three fixes are in. Which layout should Session details use?
steps.notice: All three now: no "Session" label — the name leads the card; × and + are small round buttons; tag icons sit level with the words.
steps.risk: The sample session has only one tag, so "On this session" looks emptier than it would with several.

variants.label: One Tags card
variants.summary: This session's tags first, big; then "Add a tag" with the search and the rest, all in one card.
variants.risk: Applied and available share a card; the split is size and a small label.

variants.label: Two cards of pills
variants.summary: "On this session" in its own card of big pills; "More tags" holds the search, the rest and + New tag.
variants.risk: One more card, so a little taller.

variants.label: Applied as a list
variants.summary: "On this session" is one row per tag with a Remove button; "More tags" as in B.
variants.risk: Tallest when a session has many tags.

steps.path: Session details → + Add a note, type, close and reopen
steps.headline: The note now reads like a project's description: in quotes and italics.
steps.notice: Click the note to edit it; the editing box is italic too, so nothing jumps.
steps.risk: A long note makes the top card tall and pushes the tags down.

variants.label: No note yet
variants.summary: A small dashed "+ Add a note" under the name.

steps.path: Any tag pill: Session details, the session list, Resume, the close prompt
steps.headline: Round × and + buttons and level icons apply to every tag in the app, not just this page.
steps.notice: The × and + are now small round buttons, easier to see and hit; the tag icon no longer rides above the word.
steps.risk: The round button makes each pill about 4 px wider.

variants.label: In the session list
variants.summary: The same pills in the list under the session name.
